description: Global AI behavior for this site. Sets which provider and model run by default, how long calls can take, and whether every call is logged. Per-call overrides in consumer apps always win over these defaults.

fields.options:
How this works. Consumer apps (Excom, DocPulse, BNS, etc.) call generate(), extract(), or query() without naming a provider. The dispatcher resolves: caller override → template override → these defaults. Set sensible defaults here once; consumers stay provider-agnostic.

Quick recommended setup:
1. Create an AI Provider (Claude Code for Pro plan, or Anthropic with an API key)
2. Click Fetch Models in the provider doc
3. Set Default Provider + Default Model below
4. Leave timeouts/tokens at defaults unless you have a reason to change
5. Keep Enable Logging on — needed for cost tracking and async result delivery

fields.label: Default Provider
fields.description: Which AI Provider runs calls when the consumer app doesn't specify one. Pick the cheapest provider that meets your latency + capability needs. For Claude Pro/Max subscribers: use a provider with type 'Anthropic' + Auth Token (OAuth) — fastest path. For pay-as-you-go: 'Anthropic' + API Key. For zero-config local routing: 'Claude Code' (shells out to CLI, slower).

fields.label: Default Model
fields.description: Model ID from the provider's catalog (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-5, claude-opus-4-7, claude-haiku-4-5). Sonnet = balanced default (good quality, ~$3/M input). Opus = highest quality, ~5x cost. Haiku = cheapest + fastest, use for high-volume low-stakes calls (vision OCR, classification). Must match a model_id listed inside the chosen Default Provider.

fields.label: API Call Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Max seconds to wait for the provider to respond before raising. 120s suits most generation tasks. Raise to 300s for long vision/PDF extractions (many pages) or large query results. Lower (30-60s) if you're calling synchronously from a user-facing flow where waiting is bad UX.

fields.label: Max Output Tokens
fields.description: Ceiling on response length per call. 4096 is safe for emails, summaries, query answers. Raise to 8192-16000 for long-form generation (reports, drafts). Higher = more cost per call. Anthropic Sonnet 4.x supports up to 64000 output tokens; Opus up to 32000. Caller can override per-call via the max_tokens parameter.

fields.label: Max PDF Pages
fields.description: When extract() is called on a PDF, this many pages are rasterized to images and sent to the vision model. Each image adds ~1500 input tokens. 10 pages covers most invoices, POs, lab reports. Raise to 30-50 for full contracts; cost grows linearly. Set to 1-3 to force consumers to be deliberate about which page they're extracting.

fields.label: Enable Call Logging
fields.description: When ON: every call writes an AI Call Log row (prompt, response, tokens, cost, latency, status). Required for async delivery — consumers poll the log by name. Required for cost auditing. Required for debugging failures. Turn OFF only if you have a strict data-retention rule against storing prompts/responses. Logs auto-clear after 90 days (see hooks.py default_log_clearing_doctypes).

fields.label: Base Currency
fields.description: Every call is converted to this currency once, at call time, so spend from providers that bill in different currencies can be totalled honestly. Changing it does not rewrite past calls. The dashboard can display any currency you like on top of it.

fields.label: Routing
fields.description: Callers ask for a capability, not a model. Rules are matched most-specific first (app + function, then function, then catch-all); later rules by priority act as fallbacks when a provider is rate-limited, timing out or erroring.

fields.label: Fall Back to Next Rule on Retryable Failure
fields.description: Rate limits, timeouts and 5xx only. Auth and configuration errors never retry.

fields.label: Monthly Budget
fields.description: 0 = no monthly cap. Calendar month, in base currency.

fields.label: On Exceed
fields.description: Warn logs and notifies but lets calls through. Block refuses them before they cost anything.

fields.label: Alert At (%)
fields.description: Notify System Managers once spend crosses this share of a cap.

fields.label: Per-App Caps
fields.description: Optional. Stops one app draining the budget the others need.

name: AI Settings
